verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing product catalog and search API, so agent checkout is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only product search and lookup, buy URLs with affiliate attribution, and MPP payment for Channel3's own API usage. Nothing documents a checkout session, a delegated payment credential, or order confirmation for a merchant purchase, and the UCP integration is described as covering only search and lookup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can complete a purchase end-to-end — checkout session, delegated payment credential, confirmed order
